# laravelforge_webhook (Data Source)

Fetches a single Laravel Forge site deployment webhook by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the webhook.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the site the webhook belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `url` (String) URL the webhook posts to on deployment.
